closure: Identifier resume across restart verified; general answer recognition remains constrained to the narrow supply syntax above — broader natural-language answers are clarified, not guessed, and belong in the structured interpretation mechanism. (Owner-directed boundary, implemented.)
interpretation_contract: six classes: answer | question | cancel | selection | new_instruction | unresolved; unrecognized text is UNRESOLVED, never an answer by default
an answer is recognized only with an EXACT value span into the original message: requirement-anchored frame with a DIGIT-BEARING tail, a digit-bearing reply, or an explicitly quoted span
unanchored multi-word non-digit values (e.g. 'Research and Development', 'Acme, Inc' unquoted) ASK; the quoted form binds verbatim (recorded contract change)
ambiguity (several spans) and several open requirements produce specific clarifications with zero writes
pre-persistence preservation on the proposed artifact; post-write readback + revision-guarded restore only as exceptional recovery
boundary: SUPPLY = a bare digit value, or an explicitly quoted value inside a requirement-anchored frame; coordination in either form asks; everything else — prose, mentions, negations, questions, selections, fresh directives — never writes. Values are exact spans of the user's own text; preservation is enforced pre-persistence with post-write recovery under a race guard; settlement requires verified fulfillment; the ledger dedups and expires. (Independent-reviewer closing statement, round 7.)
